body: LocalAI is the open-source AI engine. Run any model - LLMs, vision, voice, image, video - on any hardware. No GPU required.
plain_description: **Run AI models on your own machines for chats, documents, images, speech, and video.** Give your team a web interface, agents, and tools for working with files. Use it on a laptop, server, or desktop app, with or without a GPU.
technical_description: LocalAI is an open-source engine for running more than 80 model backends on local hardware. It provides OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, a web interface for chats, agents, files, and model management, plus desktop, container, and Kubernetes deployment options. Supported capabilities include text generation, vision, speech, image and video generation, embeddings, and reranking.
title: LocalAI
